usage: cox chair run [-h] [--once] [--interval INTERVAL] [--dry-run]
                     [--max-overruns MAX_OVERRUNS] [--label LABEL] [--profile PROFILE]

Each tick beats the chair lease, gathers facts, plans, performs and reports one status line.
It yields to `cox route chair take --steal`: actions planned under a lost lease are fenced.
It hard-stops at the profile's weekly_hard_stop_fraction of the weekly ceiling.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --once                run one tick, release the lease, exit 1 if the tick errored
  --interval INTERVAL   seconds between ticks (default: 60)
  --dry-run             plan and report each tick without taking the lease or performing any
                        action
  --max-overruns MAX_OVERRUNS
                        exit 3 after this many facts-stage overruns in a row (default: 3; 0
                        disables)
  --label LABEL         the chair's holder label (default: $COX_SESSION_LABEL, else unlabeled)
  --profile PROFILE     the routing profile (default: ~/.config/agent-tools/profile.yaml or
                        $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
